title: A long directed cycle from large minimum degree
statement: Let $D$ be a strict digraph on a finite, nonempty vertex set, and let $k$ be a positive integer such that $\max\{\delta^{-}(D),\delta^{+}(D)\}=k$, where $\delta^{-}(D)$ and $\delta^{+}(D)$ denote the minimum indegree and minimum outdegree of $D$. Then $D$ contains a directed cycle of length at least $k+1$.
hypotheses_covered: max of minimum indegree and minimum outdegree equals k
